entities.description: An elderly woman with short, wavy blonde hair is shown in profile, wearing a black sleeveless top and a delicate gold necklace. She is embracing a shirtless young man, with her hand resting on his chest and his arm wrapped around her waist, set against a kitchen background with wooden cabinets and a stainless steel microwave.

attributes.skin: fair with visible age spots and wrinkles

entities.description: A woman with dark, voluminous curly hair is smiling warmly while embracing a shirtless man, her hand resting on his chest. She is wearing a red sleeveless dress with white polka dots, and the man is wearing blue jeans with a brown leather belt.

A shirtless young man with curly light brown hair stands in the center, wearing blue jeans with a brown leather belt, while embracing a woman in a red polka-dot dress on his left and an older woman in a black sleeveless top on his right. He has a gentle, downward-looking expression, and the women are smiling warmly at him, with their hands placed on his chest in a group hug.
